title: Polynomial-time variable header access
statement: Let $s$ produce bit strings and let $u$ produce unary-encoded natural numbers, and suppose both functions are polynomial-time computable. Then the function that, on input $x$, selects from the header $s(x)$ the field whose index is the natural number represented by $u(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: If a header producer and a unary index producer are polynomial-time computable, then so is the function selecting the header field at the produced index: a counted sequence of native tail projections followed by one first projection.
